notes: Synthetic: authored from Mistral's official SDK, github.com/mistralai/client-python at 90e3009 (2026-10-28), whose models are generated by Speakeasy from Mistral's OpenAPI spec: models/chatcompletionresponse.py, chatcompletionchoice.py (finish_reason stop, length, model_length, error, tool_calls), assistantmessage.py, toolcall.py (function, id, type, index), usageinfo.py, completionchunk.py, completionresponsestreamchoice.py, deltamessage.py; the stream is data-only and ends with data: [DONE] (chat.py); errors/httpvalidationerror.py and models/validationerror.py for a 422; the API error body the SDK's error hook reads (extra/observability/otel.py) and its test (extra/tests/test_otel_tracing.py). Mistral's spec itself (Speakeasy registry, docs.mistral.ai) was not reachable from the authoring sandbox. mistral-large-latest is the model the SDK's README and tests use. Naming: the mistral preset (providers/presets.go); the directory is the key as contracttest.ModelDir encodes it. error_invalid_model is the SDK test's error body verbatim; its HTTP status there is 400. The SDK types no 401 body, so none is pinned. FunctionCall.arguments may be an object as well as a string per the SDK; the fixtures use the string form, and an object would fail the whole decode. responses_text, stream_responses_text and responses_error_invalid_model drive the /v1/responses passthrough (responses.py, operation create_response_v1_responses_post): CreateResponseResponse for application/json, and for text/event-stream ResponsesStreamFrame {event, data}, so every event is named and its data carries the same type (16 types, no sentinel: the SDK's EventStream has none); the ids, timestamps, text and token counts are placeholders. list_models drives ListModels (models_.py, GET /v1/models): ModelList {object, data[] BaseModelCard | FTModelCard by type}, one base card with placeholder values, filed here because the request names no model; the operation types no 4XX body but a 422, so no list_models error is pinned.
